name: Yukinojo
source:
Yukibito - Snow Spirit

Weakness: No sense of taste

"Offer your body to me, now."

When you first met Yukinojo he acted like a kindhearted gentleman, but now that he's marked you as his, he's cold as ice.

"This feels good, right? I know you like it..."

Chikage: "Yukinojo is usually smiling, so he's really scary when he gets mad. He's a mystery. I never know what he's thinking."
Kyoga: "Yuki is nice, but he's so sensitive...It probably wouldn't be a good idea to choose him."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
